title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 

- Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. 

- You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 

- You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. 

- You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

- You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 

- You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. 

- You have nothing more to learn : Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will: 

- This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting 

- Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close 

- Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers 

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 

Minimum requirements for this role: 

- Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition

- Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role

- Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement 

- Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles 

- Value-based selling approach

- Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment 

- MEDDIC experience 

- Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 

- Highly collaborative with a growth mindset 

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Anthropic Fellows Program, AI Safety & Security
description:
About Anthropic 

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Applications are now open for our January cohort - apply here. 

Anthropic Fellows Program overview 

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

What to expect 

- 4 months of full-time research 

- Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers 

- Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK)

- Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community

- Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)

- Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process 

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation 

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

Across the workstreams, you may be a good fit if you: 

- Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole

- Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic

- Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics

- Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments

- Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Strong candidates may also have: 

- Strong background in a discipline relevant to a specific Fellows workstream (e.g. economics, social sciences, or cybersecurity)

- Experience in areas of research or engineering related to their workstream

Candidates must be: 

- Fluent in Python programming

- Available to work full-time on the Fellows program

AI Safety Fellows 

Mentors, research areas, & past projects 

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include:

- Sam Bowman

- Sara Price

- Alex Tamkin

- Nina Panickssery

- Trenton Bricken

- Logan Graham

- Jascha Sohl-Dickstein

- Joe Benton

- Collin Burns

- Fabien Roger

- Samuel Marks

- Kyle Fish

- Ethan Perez

Our mentors will lead projects in select AI safety research areas, such as:

- Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.

- Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.

- Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.

- Model Internals / Mechanistic Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.

- AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.

On our Alignment Science and Frontier Red Team blogs, you can read about past projects, including:

- Subliminal Learning: Language Models Transmit Behavioral Traits via Hidden Signals in Data: Alex Cloud and Minh Le, et al., mentors including Samuel Marks and Owain Evans

- Open-source circuits: Michael Hanna and Mateusz Piotrowski with mentorship from Emmanuel Ameisen and Jack Lindsey

For a full list of representative projects for each area, please see these blog posts: Introducing the Anthropic Fellows Program for AI Safety Research , Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions .

Unique candidate criteria 

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

- Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems

- Have experience with empirical ML research projects

- Have experience working with large language models

- Have experience in one of the research areas mentioned above

- Have a track record of open-source contributions

AI Security Fellows 

Mentors, research areas, & past projects 

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include:

- Nicholas Carlini

- Keri Warr

- Evyatar Ben Asher

- AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits: Winnie Xiao and Cole Killian, mentored by Nicholas Carlini and Alwin Peng

- Strengthening Red Teams: A Modular Scaffold for Control Evaluations: Chloe Loughridge et al., mentored by Jon Kutasov and Joe Benton

Unique candidate criteria 

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

- Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems

- Have contributed to open-source projects in LLM- or security-adjacent repositories

- Have demonstrated success in bringing clarity and ownership to ambiguous technical problems

- Have experience with pentesting, vulnerability research, or other offensive security work

- Have a demonstrated willingness to do the "dirty work" that produces high-quality outputs

description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

title: Pricing Data Scientist
description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office) 

Pricing at Marshmallow 

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

What you’ll be doing 

- Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.

- Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.

- Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.

- Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.

- Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.

- Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.

- Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.

- Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you? 

- Proactive : You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities 

- Modeller : You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models

- Commercial : You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact

- Curious : You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further

- Owner : You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area

- Opinionated : You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way

- Explainer : You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts

- Networker : You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you? 

- Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R

- Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R

- At least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role

Perks of the job 

- Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

- Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

- Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

- Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

- 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. 

Our process 

- Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

- Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

- Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)

- Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought 

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Director Care & Clinics Marketing
description:
Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. Our ambition is to become the operating layer for entire industries. Care Homes and Clinics are part of our priority verticals.

We’re looking for a Director Care & Clinics Marketing to build our position in these markets as part of a world-class vertical marketing team. You’ll combine deep customer understanding, a clear industry point of view and commercial judgement to turn an opportunity into a repeatable way to win.

You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Care Homes and Clinics, partnering closely with the Care Sales Manager and Clinics Sales Manager and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams.

What you’ll do

- Understand the market and choose where to focus. Interview customers and specialist partners to uncover buying triggers, workflows and unmet needs. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities among groups operating multiple care homes, clinics or practices.

- Define the proposition. Turn customer insight into clear positioning, competitive arguments and a credible industry point of view. Work with Product Marketing to create customer stories, demonstrations and sales kits that show why Light matters to each segment.

- Own the marketing pipeline. Build the model, set campaign priorities and lead execution with Demand Generation and Field Marketing. Own weekly reporting on qualified opportunities, conversion and progress against pipeline targets, with clear actions when performance falls short.

- Make AI part of the operating rhythm. Use AI for research, campaign execution and reporting that gets to the why behind the numbers. Investigate what drives conversion and where deals stall, validate the findings with customer and Sales evidence, and turn them into decisions.

- Be a true partner to Sales. Train direct sales reps and SDRs on the nuances of Care Homes and Clinics: their buyers, language, workflows and objections. Join important customer conversations and equip the team with the insight and proof needed to move deals forward.

- Build credibility in the sector. Speak at conferences, webinars and industry discussions. Develop relationships with the press, analysts, influencers and specialist partners who shape how buyers think, bringing a useful perspective grounded in customer experience.

- Bring the customer voice into the product. Partner with Product Marketing to define the workflows, integrations and product requirements critical to these sectors. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver.

- Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message and campaigns.

What you’ll bring

- Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results.

- Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change.

- An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with the press, analysts and influencers.

- Experience working with specialist partners and building trusted relationships within Care Homes, Clinics or a closely related sector.

- A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility.

- Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request.

- Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

- Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results.

- You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both.

What success looks like

Clear priorities for Care Homes and Clinics, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next.

Sales reps and SDRs understand the nuances of each segment and have the training, content and customer proof to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most.

You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value.

How we work

Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort.

This is an opportunity to shape a priority market from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering.

The good stuff

🏢 In-office, five days a week, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary. 
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. 
🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal. 
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Care Homes & Clinics actually do business. 
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

How to apply

Tell us about a specialist market you helped grow: how you built the pipeline, earned credibility with customers and partners, and equipped Sales to win. Share a time your analysis changed the plan, and how customer insight shaped a product requirement.

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Role 

A fast-paced, global business with significant growth ambitions, and an Accounting function entering a period of transformation to support that growth. This is an exciting opportunity to drive that agenda, with full ownership of the numbers and the scope to shape what comes next for the function.

Reporting directly to the VP, Controllership and working in a leadership team alongside Reporting, Risk, and Payroll, the Director, Accounting holds full accountability for the completeness and accuracy of the Global General Ledger across the full P&L and Balance Sheet. This role will lead a team of accounting professionals and drive an improvement agenda that scales the function to meet the demands of a fast-paced business — through hands-on ownership of the numbers, critical thinking on every estimate and judgement, and continued development of the function beyond process compliance.

What You’ll Do 

Own the Global General Ledger & Financial Close 

- Ultimate accountability for the Global GL under US GAAP, including the completeness, accuracy, and timely close of all entities worldwide

- Build and lead a scalable end-to-end close operating model; set standards, drive consistency, and coach the team to execute with rigour

- Maintain the quality of balance sheet reconciliations and close deliverables; identify and resolve issues in a timely manner, applying critical evaluation alongside sound accounting and commercial judgement

- Estimates, accruals, and accounting positions that accurately reflect the pace and trajectory of the business, with the accounting telling the true story behind the numbers

- Deliver authoritative monthly and quarterly P&L and balance sheet flux analysis — clear on commercial and accounting drivers, risks and opportunities, and material one-off items 

Apply and Uphold Technical Accounting Standards 

- The senior escalation point for accounting matters across the business; research, document, and defend positions on complex and novel issues

- Provide technical accounting support to business growth and commercial deals, including under ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition) and other judgement-intensive areas

- Ground accounting in US GAAP principles and policies, with technical rigour as the baseline

- Evaluate the accounting treatment of commercial arrangements with technical precision and commercial awareness

- Critical thinking on every judgement call, with standard methodology as a starting point rather than a substitute for judgement 

Drive Continuous Improvement 

- Own the improvement agenda — simplify, standardise, and automate close processes, leading with the adoption of AI and enabling technology

- Partner across Finance, Enterprise Systems and AI Enablement on systems transformation that scales the function for the future

- Define and embed quality standards, governance frameworks, and documentation requirements across a geographically dispersed team

- Partner with Finance Operations and the Center of Excellence to maintain clear ownership and consistent execution across time zones (US West Coast, US East Coast, UK, India). 

Lead & Develop the Team 

- Coach and develop a team of accounting professionals, building technical capability and succession depth within the function

- Create a high-performing team culture grounded in clear expectations, mutual accountability, meaningful development, and direct, honest communication

Partner Across the Organisation 

- Build strong relationships with Finance and Commercial business partners; bring commercial perspective to accounting judgements

- Represent the Accounting function with confidence and credibility at senior management level 

What You’ll Bring 

Experience & Qualifications 

- Fully-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent)

- Significant post-qualification experience in financial accounting leadership, with full GL accountability and ownership of the end-to-end close cycle across a complex, multi-entity, global business — including the completeness and accuracy of the numbers

- Proven track record of leading and developing teams of qualified accountants and people managers 

Skills & Ways of Working 

- Deep technical grounding in US GAAP, with the confidence to take and defend positions on complex matters

- Numbers-first with strong ownership of accuracy — credible at senior stakeholder level, telling the story behind the numbers and comfortable pushing back when warranted

- A natural change leader with an improvement mindset — builds the case, brings the team along, and delivers lasting change at pace

- A high-performing people leader, invested in growth and outcomes

- At ease in fast-paced, global complexity, fluent across both strategic and detailed work

Benefits and Perks

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx) 

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team 

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing 

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done 

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

- You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

- You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

- You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation 

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits 

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks 

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process 

- Talent Screening (30 minutes)

- Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

- Skills Assessment & Panel (45 minutes)

- Values Interview (60 minutes)

- Meet the CEO/CPO/VP Eng (40 minutes)

- We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity 

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps 

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

description:

While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The role 

This is a full-time Collections Administrator role with hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in the Milton Keynes office).

The role will be responsible for managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy. Day-to-day tasks include administration and reconciliation tasks, updating case management systems, reviewing and processing both hard copy and digital correspondence and liaising with third parties. No prior collections or financial services experience is required — we’ll provide full training on regulation, systems and processes; what matters most is the right attitude, judgement and attention to detail.

Who you are 

We're looking for someone who has, or is keen to develop, the following:

- No prior collections or financial services experience necessary — full training will be provided on FCA regulation (including CONC7), DPA requirements and our internal processes

- Willing to learn about the broad range of debt solutions, e.g. Payment Arrangements, DMPs, IVAs, Trust Deeds, DROs, Breathing Space etc.

- Good Microsoft Excel skills, or a willingness to quickly get up to speed with VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, linking sheets etc.

- Strong attention to detail and consistency, with the discipline to follow pre-defined procedures across multiple IT systems

- A team player who will help as required to deliver tasks within the team SLAs

- Familiar with KPIs and targets and quality assurance requirements

- A flexible team member who can adapt quickly to changing requirements and business demands

What you'll be doing 

- Collections administration, managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy

- Reconciliation of customer loans and completing admin work in line with pre-defined procedures

- Updating case management systems

- Reviewing and processing hard copy and digital correspondence

- Liaising with customers and their third party representatives, e.g., Field suppliers, debt collection agencies, insolvency portfolio managers

- Assessing customer affordability using our industry leading Open Banking software 

What we offer 

- Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

- 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

- 2 paid volunteering days per year

- Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

- One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

- Employee loan

- Free gym membership

- Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

- Engage with customers - Join customer calls to present analysis results, walk through findings, and gather feedback that shapes the product.

- Build investigation automation - Create AI-powered tools that scale investigation and threat hunting workflows across our platform.

- Background working in a SOC environment or Managed Detection and Response.

- Customer-facing technical experience

- Make a real world impact . Help empower cybersecurity teams around the world to keep people safe from the most advanced cyber threats.

- Push the boundaries of technology . Work with and build the most advanced AI capabilities in the world of cybersecurity, including cutting-edge analytics and agentic platforms. Your ideas will shape the product and the industry.

- Innovative culture. We obsess about customers, move fast with high quality, and value open communication, mentorship and learning. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and want to apply your expertise to build AI-powered defenses against advanced threats, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES 

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

- Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

- Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

- Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). 

Vous bénéficierez de :

- 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

- flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

- télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

- Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

- Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

- A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses : 
Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois 
Description de poste ici

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description:
Wanna join the adventure? 

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.

About this role: 

- Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.

- Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.

- Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.

- Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.

- Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review

- Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.

- Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.

- In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves: 

- 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.

- Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows

- Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).

- Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).

- Understanding of distributed architecture.

- Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP , TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.

- Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

- Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves: 

- Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.

- Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.

- Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)

- Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ / NATS , etc.)

- Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S , systemd-nspawn)

- Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits: 

- Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success

- Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best

- Health and life insurance, we care about your health

- Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand )

- Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

- Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together

- Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

* Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. 

Who We Are 

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. 

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role 

As Account Management Lead – Editions France , you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You’ll Be Doing 

- 
Editions Strategy & Growth

- 
Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

- 
Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

- 
Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

- 
Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

- 
Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

- 
Occupancy & Commercial Performance

- 
Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

- 
Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

- 
Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

- 
Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

- 
P&L Ownership & Governance

- 
Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

- 
Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

- 
Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

- 
Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

- 
Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

- 
Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

- 
Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

- 
Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

- 
Senior Stakeholder Management

- 
Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

- 
Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

- 
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

- 
Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You’ll Need to Thrive 

- 
7+ years working in commercially focused roles

- 
Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

- 
Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

- 
Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

- 
Mix of both strategy and execution experience

- 
Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

- 
Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

- 
Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

- 
Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

- 
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

- 
You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

- 
Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

- 
Fluent in French and English is required

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do 

- Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: 

- Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

- Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

- Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

- Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

- Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

Project Management: 

- Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

- Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

- Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

Mentorship & Coaching: 

- Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

- Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

Analytical & Problem-Solving: 

- Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

- Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

- Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: 

- Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

- Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

- Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

Driving Organisational Change: 

- Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

- Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have 

- Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

- Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

- Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

- Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

- Fluent English & French is a prerequisite 

Experience 

- Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

- Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

- Change management using agile methodologies.

- Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

Other Requirements: 

- Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

- Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

- Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

- Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

- Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.
