title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the Role 

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.

- You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

- You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.

- You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

- Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn

- Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.

- Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling

- Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles

- 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

- Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales

- Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles

- Excellent communication skills, verbal and written

- Curious and able to ask insightful questions

- A champion of a Growth Mindset

- Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience in closing-sales roles

- Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

- Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment

- Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways

- Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways 

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

- ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.

- The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.

- The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

description:
About Telnyx 

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. 

The Role 

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Paris — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model 

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. 

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do 

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Mistral Large, CroissantLLM, or other French/European sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for French language use cases and EU-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, French data sovereignty, etc)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable

What We're Looking For

• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency

Bonus Points For

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
description:
About us 

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

- French and USA payroll and entity obligations

- European employees through an EOR setup

- Growing Paris and New York offices

- Multiple benefits providers and external partners

- An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees .

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

- Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

- Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

- Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

- Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

- Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

- Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

- Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

- Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

- Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

- Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

- Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

- Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

- Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

- Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

- Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

- Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

- HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

- Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

- Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

- Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

- Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

- Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls 

- HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

- A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

- Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

- High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

- Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

- Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

- Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it. 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description:
About Anthropic 

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role 

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities 

- Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there

- Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice

- Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion

- Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP

- Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation

- Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements

- Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages

- Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn

- Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time

You may be a good fit if you have 

- 15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government

- The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset

- Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place

- A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal

- A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams

- Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes

- Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers

- Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues

- Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it

- The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials

- Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both

- Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it 

- A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions

À propos du poste 

En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.

Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. La première année, la réussite se mesurera moins à un grand chiffre qu'à votre capacité à installer Anthropic auprès de l'État français : une stratégie claire, les bonnes fondations et nos premiers accords stratégiques.

Responsabilités 

- Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains d'action, nos leviers de succès et ce qu'il nous faut construire pour y parvenir

- Incarner Anthropic au plus haut niveau auprès de l'État français, en nouant des relations de confiance avec les cabinets ministériels, les cadres dirigeants de l'administration et les responsables du numérique et de la technologie des plus grands ministères, dont la défense, les finances et la justice

- Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension

- Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de partenariat, accords-cadres et centrales d'achat telles que l'UGAP

- Collaborer au quotidien avec notre responsable des affaires publiques en France, pour que les démarches commerciales et politiques se renforcent mutuellement, en cohérence avec la stratégie et la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'IA

- Mener les échanges clients sur la souveraineté des données, la sécurité et la conformité (par exemple SecNumCloud et la doctrine « cloud au centre »), et travailler avec les équipes Sécurité, Juridique et Produit sur la façon dont nous répondons à ces exigences

- Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps

- Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements

- Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France

Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez 

- Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française

- L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ

- Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore

- Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation

- Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques

- Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente

- Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients

- L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles

- Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction

- La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau

- Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues

- La disponibilité pour engager une procédure d'habilitation de sécurité si certains comptes l'exigent

description:

If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

Attributes We Value 

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

The opportunity 

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand , while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do 

Lead and coach the team 

- Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

- Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

- Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

- Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy 

- Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

- Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

- Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

- Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

- Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth 

- Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

- Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

- Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

- Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system 

- Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

- Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

- Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

- Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

- Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues 

- Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

- Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

- Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like 

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

- priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

- onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

- leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

- GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

- recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

- the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are 

- 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

- 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

- Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

- Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

- Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

- Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

- Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

- Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

- Fluent French and professional English.

- Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience 

- Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

- KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

- Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

- Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

- Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for 

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

title: Stage de 6 mois UX/UI Designer (H/F/N) – PARIS
description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne.

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Vous rejoignez l'équipe produit 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design, que vous aimez transformer une donnée complexe en visuel et que vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des interfaces au service de vrais enjeux data, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics. 

Ekimetrics est leader en data science et fournisseur de solutions AI. Depuis plus de 20 ans, nous utilisons la data science au service de l’optimisation de performance marketing, business et de la transition vers une performance plus durable. 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design d’interfaces élégantes et intuitives, que vous aimez transformer des idées en prototypes concrets et que vous rêvez d’expérimenter avec l’IA, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics ! 

Pourquoi recrutons nous ? 

L'équipe Produit conçoit des solutions data-driven et logiciels métier , centrées sur l'utilisateur, qui aident nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions business à partir de leurs données. 

Design, data science et développement travaillent main dans la main sur des problèmes concrets. 

Elle compte 30 personnes (full-stack developers, Product managers, Product owners, DevOps et Product designers) qui construisent les plateformes de data science et d'IA que nos clients utilisent au quotidien pour piloter leurs décisions. 

Pour accélérer la production de ces interfaces, améliorer les parcours de nos utilisateurs et recueillir leurs retours, nous recrutons un·e stagiaire UX/UI Designer, suivi·e par un product designer senior, avec une vraie autonomie sur des projets complets menés en s'appuyant sur le design system Ekimetrics, les méthodes agiles et selon la méthode du double diamant. 

Le process de recrutement : 

- Un entretien RH, 

- Un entretien technique sur site 

- Un entretien final. 

Est attendu un portfolio démontrant d'au moins 3 projets variés ainsi qu'une expertise Figma et UI avancés 

Vos missions : 

- 
Concevoir des flows, wireframes et maquettes : pas des écrans isolés, mais des parcours qui aident nos clients à décider. 

- 
Contribuer au design system : comprendre pourquoi une règle existe avant de l'appliquer, puis la faire évoluer sans casser la cohérence entre nos produits. 

- 
Participer aux ateliers UX et aux tests d'utilisabilité (Maze), et proposer des solutions argumentées. 

- 
Travailler avec les product designers, les product owners et les développeurs. 

Profil recherché : 

- 
Bac+5 en cours, en design, UX/UI ou multimédia interactif. 

- 
Vous suivez les nouveaux produits et les tendances (design systems, IA appliquée au produit, nouvelles interactions), et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi ils fonctionnent. 

- 
Vous maîtrisez Figma en profondeur (variables, auto-layout, composants). 

- 
Pour vous, un design system est un système de règles, pas une bibliothèque de composants. Une connaissance de shadcn/ui ou d'un système équivalent est un plus. 

- 
Vous défendez vos choix avec des arguments, pas seulement avec du goût. 

- 
Vous gérez seul·e votre temps et vos priorités. 

- 
Vous êtes proactif·ve et fiable sur les deadlines : vous partagez idées, doutes et avancement réel sans attendre qu'on vous le demande. 

Les petits plus : 

- Des connaissances en accessibilité web seront appréciées 

- Des compétences à restituer en vidéo et sous forme de slides 

Modalités : 

- 
Stage de 6 mois, démarrage prévu entre janvier et mars 2027. 

- 
Software : Jira, Figma et Maze. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.   

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. 

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. 

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être   : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. 

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.    

Vous aurez accès : 

- 
Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School. 

- 
A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;

De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;

Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)

Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours. 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. 

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog. 

About the job 

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

- 
One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

- 
Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.

What you’ll do 

- 
Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.

- 
Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

- 
Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.

- 
Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

- 
Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.

- 
Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.

- 
Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.

- 
Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.

- 
Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.

- 
Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise

- 
Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

- 
Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.

- Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.

- Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.

- Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.

- Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.

- You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.

Partner with customers and internal teams 

- 
Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.

- 
Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.

- 
Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.

- 
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

- 
Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

Identify risks and opportunities 

- 
Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.

- 
Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.

- 
Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.

- 
Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

Improve how we work 

- 
Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.

- 
Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

- 
Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

- 
Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

What you’ll need to succeed 

- 
Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.

- 
Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

- 
Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

- 
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.

- 
Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.

- 
Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.

- 
Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.

- 
Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.

- 
Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.

- 
Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

- 
Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

- 
Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.

- 
Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.

- 
Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.

- 
Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.

- 
Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.

- 
Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.

- 
Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

Why you should join Contentsquare 

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the Role 

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.

- You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

- You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.

- You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

- Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn

- Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.

- Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling

- Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles

- 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

- Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales

- Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles

- Excellent communication skills, verbal and written

- Curious and able to ask insightful questions

- A champion of a Growth Mindset

- Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience in closing-sales roles

- Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

- Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment

- Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways

- Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways 

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

- ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.

- The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.

- The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. description:
Notre équipe Ship & Back recherche un·e Software Development Engineer Full-Stack basé·e à Lille ou Paris. 

Au sein du domaine Value Chain , notre équipe Ship & Back assure la livraison des commandes e-commerce, leur suivi, ainsi que les retours (entrepôt et magasin) pour l'ensemble de nos pays via 5 produits clés. Tu rejoindras le produit Trackbox , le cœur névralgique qui assure : Le suivi en temps réel des commandes jusqu’au client final ainsi que l'animation visuelle de nos performances de livraison via une interface dédié au pilotage du Delivery On Time (DOT) et du Carrier On Time (COT) .

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Nos applications sont Business Critical : sans Trackbox, pas de communication client et pas de pilotage de nos indicateurs clés de livraison !

Notre défi 2026-2027 : Transformer notre architecture historique vers un modèle Event-Driven moderne, modulaire et hautement scalable. Tu intègreras une équipe agile de 6 passionné·es où l'entraide, le clean code et l'excellence opérationnelle rythment nos journées.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

Au quotidien, tu participeras à la fois au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'écosystème actuel et à la conception de la nouvelle architecture target. Ton rôle sera clé pour :

- 
Concevoir & Scaler : Participer aux choix d'architecture pour absorber la montée en charge des flux de livraison mondiaux.

- 
Intégrer & Piloter : Raccorder de nouveaux transporteurs et enrichir nos tableaux de bord de performance (DOT/COT).

- 
Élever les standards : Contribuer aux bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie et réduire la charge de maintenance ( low run ).

STACK TECHNIQUE 

- 
Back-end (Cœur du poste - 80%) : Java 25, Spring Boot 3+

- 
Front-end (Ajustements UI & Dashboards - 20%) : React 

- 
Architecture : Microservices, REST, Event-Driven (Kafka)

- 
Cloud & Ops : GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD

- 
Observabilité : Datadog, SonarQube

CE QUE TU APPORTES 

Fort·e d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience , tu maîtrises le développement d'applications critiques et complexes.

- 
Expertise Backend : Solide maîtrise de l'écosystème Java / Spring Boot.

- 
Frontend (React) : Capacité à intervenir de manière autonome sur une interface existante pour intégrer des fonctionnalités ou adapter des composants visuels.

- 
Architecture & Résilience : Expérience en conception de systèmes distribués (idéalement Event-Driven / Kafka) visant un haut niveau de disponibilité et une maintenance simplifiée.

- 
Culture Qualité : Exigence sur le Clean Code, le respect des standards de sécurité et le taux de couverture de tests.

- 
Esprit Collectif & Mentorat : Goût pour le travail en équipe (pair/mob programming), les revues de code constructives et le partage de connaissances.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS 

- 
Organisation de travail hybride ;

- 
Indemnisation et cadre structuré pour les périodes d'astreinte ;

- 
Matériel performant au choix (Mac ou Windows) ;

- 
Développement des compétences (certifications techniques, formations) ;

- 
Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Data Product Manager - Core Data Product (f/m/d)
description:
Notre équipe Core Data Product, au sein du Data CoE (centre d'expertise data), recherche un·e Data Product Manager à Paris 

DECATHLON accélère sa transformation pour devenir LA plateforme numérique sportive mondiale. Le digital et l’IA sont les moteurs de notre ambition 2026-2030 pour rendre le sport durablement accessible. Au cœur de cette stratégie, la donnée est notre actif le plus critique. Notre défi ? La rendre accessible, de confiance et actionnable afin de pouvoir la mettre à disposition du business et de la stratégie

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

Tu seras responsable de définir la vision et la feuille de roadmap d'un produit Data, en encadrant indirectement une équipe de data engineers. Ta mission sera de rendre la donnée facile d'accès et de confiance afin d'accompagner le business à prendre des décisions orientées data!

Tes missions principales : 

- Stratégie et Vision du Produit Data 
Définition de la Roadmap : Concevoir et piloter la feuille de route des produits de données (algorithmes, tableaux de bord, API de données, plateformes d'IA).

Alignement Business : S'assurer que les initiatives data répondent aux objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise (ex: réduction du churn via le machine learning, optimisation des prix, etc.).

Identification des opportunités : Détecter les cas d'usage où la donnée peut créer un avantage concurrentiel ou améliorer l'efficacité interne.

- Gestion du Cycle de Vie de la Donnée 
Collecte et Infrastructure : Collaborer avec les Data Engineers pour s'assurer que les pipelines de données sont robustes et que les sources sont fiables.

Gouvernance et Qualité : Garantir que les données sont propres, cohérentes et conformes aux réglementations (RGPD). Il est le garant de la "vérité" des données diffusées.

Démocratisation : Rendre la donnée accessible et compréhensible pour les utilisateurs non techniques à travers l'organisation.

- Collaboration Transverse 
Interface Technique : Traduire les besoins business en spécifications techniques pour les Data Scientists et Data Engineers.

Accompagnement des Stakeholders : Éduquer les décideurs (Marketing, Ventes, Direction) sur le potentiel et les limites de la data.

Agilité : Piloter le développement des modèles de données en mode agile (sprints, tests A/B, itérations rapides).

- Analyse et Mesure de la Performance 
Définition des KPI : Établir les indicateurs de succès non seulement pour le produit final, mais aussi pour la performance des modèles (précision, rappel, temps de latence des données).

Analyse d'impact : Mesurer concrètement le retour sur investissement (ROI) des projets data mis en place.

- Éthique et Sécurité 
Éthique de l'IA : Veiller à ce que les algorithmes développés ne soient pas biaisés et respectent l'éthique de l'entreprise.

Sécurité : S'assurer que l'accès aux données sensibles est sécurisé et contrôlé.

COMPETENCE TECHNIQUE 

Data Product Strategy & Management
Data Governance & Compliance
Business Modeling
Data Architecture
Agile Methodologies
Backlog Management
SQL, Python (for data validation & automation)
Visualization Tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.)
AI/ML Integration and ability to manage predictive models.
Data Governance frameworks and compliance knowledge (GDPR, CCPA).
Real-Time Data Integration (APIs, Kafka, Streaming).
Data Modeling, Business Intelligence Tools (Tableau, Power BI).
SQL, Python, and familiarity with data platforms like Databricks and Snowflake.

CE QUE TU APPORTES 

Tes dernières expériences t’ont permis de développer un intérêt majeur pour les problématiques liées au cloud et à la donnée, tout en consolidant tes connaissances en cycle de vie produit (PLM).

- Tu justifies d'au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Product Management dans un contexte international et technique.

- User-centric : Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et sais traduire des besoins métiers complexes en parcours utilisateurs fluides.

- Impact-driven : Tu as une sensibilité forte pour l'écologie et l'éthique environnementale.

- Analytique : Tu es à l'aise avec la donnée technique et les calculs d'impact complexes.

- Sportif·ve : Tu es passionné·e de sport et souhaites mettre ton talent au service de sa pratique durable.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS 

- Organisation de travail hybride ;

- Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille.

- Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

- Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

- Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

- Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.
