🌟 What we do & why we do it 

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams. 

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong. 

___ 

The role 

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency. 

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own 

- Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

- Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

- Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

- Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

- Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are 

- You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

- You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

- You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

- You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

- Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here 

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct 

- 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

- We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

- You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like 

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply. 

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

Our core values shape how we work, ensuring consistency, trust, and purpose while guiding both individual actions and collective decisions. They’re not just words—we live them every day.

- 💌 Appreciation – We cultivate an environment of mutual respect, recognizing the unique contributions and backgrounds of every team member. Success is a team effort, and we celebrate it together.

description:

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams. 

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. You'll sit next to doinstruct's founders , and you decide which workflows move to Claude agents, what ships to production, and what gets killed. Every project you take on has to clear one bar: a 3-5x return in hours saved, revenue generated, or headcount avoided . If it doesn't clear that bar, we don't build it.

- You'd rather write a one-page memo than book a meeting to explain it.

- Real empathy for blue-collar and frontline work. Time in food, manufacturing, construction, or logistics is a strong plus, not a requirement.

- Fluent in German and English. Berlin-based or ready to relocate within 4-6 weeks.

- Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of frontline workers and shows up in company metrics inside your first quarter.

title: Internship - Founders' Office
description:
about us 

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission 

As the Founders' Office Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do: 

- help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

- take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

- support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

- help the growth team close new customers by managing legal and compliance processes

- support with our hiring pipeline, from screening candidates to scheduling interviews

- help plan and execute internal and external events and keep the office running smoothly

- work closely with Ennie and Philipp 

what makes you a great fit: 

- you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

- you're tech- & automation savvy and can learn new tools fast

- you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

- you’re a strong communicator in both English and German

- you’ve have initial (internship) experience and/or worked on side hustles or projects

- you're done or at the end of university and could imagine starting full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if: 

- you have never touched automation/AI tools or don’t have basic technical understanding

- you only want to do high-level “strategic” work

- you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

- you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

- you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters. 

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role 

You will take Langdock from first conversation to signed contract. Our customers are IT leaders, security teams, and C-Level executives at mid to large companies worldwide. This role is pivotal in driving our expansion across diverse customer segments, from innovative scale-ups and SMBs to established Global Fortune 500 clients.

You'll operate as a trusted technology and AI advisor, combining full ownership of the sales cycle with the technical depth to build real credibility with today's technical buyers - the IT leads, architects, and engineers who now sit at the table alongside business executives in every AI decision. The product sells well, but enterprise deals require someone who can navigate architectural complexity, build trust with both business and technical stakeholders, and close.

- Full-Cycle Sales Mastery: Own the entire sales lifecycle from lead qualification to closing, running technical discovery, solution scoping, and executive presentations that tie Langdock's platform to measurable business outcomes - with a seamless handover to customer success.

- Technical Credibility: Lead early-stage conversations on APIs, integrations, and system architecture directly with IT and engineering stakeholders, translating what Langdock can do at the platform level into business value for economic buyers - without leaning on a Solutions Engineer to carry the technical thread.

- Customer Success Advocacy: Build a deep understanding of customers' business models, decision-making processes, and technology landscapes, and continuously analyze customer needs to enhance their success with our solutions.

- Strategic Revenue Development: Collaborate with partnerships, marketing, and customer success to design effective go-to-market strategies, test new markets and customer segments, and explore new revenue sources for future growth.

- Market Insight: Deep understanding of our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and the ability to align solutions with their needs - and provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership to influence the roadmap.

You Might Be a Fit If… 

- You are proficient in AI technologies , with a preference for those who have previously sold AI solutions. In the best case, you have worked as a Sales Engineer or in similar positions.

- You have experience selling technical solutions to medium and large companies, with the ability to translate complex platform concepts into business value for non-technical executives. You're comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles by developing and executing account strategies that carry significant quota.

- You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, while staying credible with the technical evaluators in the room.

- You're curious and customer-centric , with a talent for understanding customers' challenges and coordinating solution design tailored to their needs.

- You're comfortable operating in a high-growth environment. 

- You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The Environment 

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps 

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

title: Security Lead - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters. 

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role 

We’re hiring a hands-on Security Lead to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do 

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security 

- Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

- Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

- Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security 

- Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

- Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

- Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation 

- Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description:
MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.

We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.

As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.

Aufgaben

What You'll Do 

Campaigns & Product Launches

You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.

This includes:

- developing campaign and launch plans

- creating timelines, responsibilities and deadlines

- coordinating content and communication across our channels

- making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when

- keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables

- identifying problems and dependencies early

- reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.

TikTok Shop & Social Commerce 

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.

You will work on:

- TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions

- Seller Center and campaign management

- livestream campaigns and activations

- product and promotional planning

- coordination with TikTok and external partners

- identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.

Marketing & Content 

You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.

You will help decide:

- which products and topics we should focus on

- how we communicate them to our audience

- which content formats and channels make sense

- how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels

We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better. 

Team & Project Coordination 

Good ideas only matter if they get executed.

You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

- coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team

- improve workflows and processes

- support and guide other team members

- take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives

- help shape marketing priorities together with the founders

There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.

Your Role Can Grow With You 

We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.

Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:

Performance & KPIs 

Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.

Marketing Budgets 

Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.

CRM & Email Marketing 

Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.

What Ownership Means at MAOMAO 

Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.

It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.

It means thinking beyond the individual task.

If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

We want someone who thinks: 

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked? 

Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems .

Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:

What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step? 

You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.

Not every idea will work. That is okay.

What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.

The mindset we're looking for is:

“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.” 

Qualifikation

Who We're Looking For

We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.

You should:

- have at least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content, campaign management or a related field

- have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level) , as you will be developing marketing for a predominantly German-speaking audience

- have strong working proficiency in English

- be highly organized, reliable and proactive

- take initiative and think ahead

- be able to turn ideas into structured plans and execution

- communicate clearly and follow through

- feel comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes

- think in solutions rather than simply escalating problems

- be willing to experiment, test and iterate quickly

- be comfortable making decisions even when not every answer is obvious

- have a strong interest in e-commerce, social media and social commerce

- be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets

- enjoy working in a fast-moving environment

- be hands-on when needed

- learn quickly and actively look for ways to improve

Experience in e-commerce, TikTok, TikTok Shop, social media, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus.

Chinese language skills are a plus but they are NOT a requirement.

Benefits

Benefits

What we offer 

- A central marketing role with a high level of ownership and room to shape how we work

- Direct collaboration with the founders

- Founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce 

- An existing marketing and content team to work with

- Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin

- Short decision-making paths and the freedom to actually implement ideas

- Plenty of room to experiment, test new formats and iterate quickly

- The opportunity to work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building 

- The opportunity to shape campaigns and launches from idea to execution instead of owning only one small part of the process

- Clear professional and personal development opportunities, including the potential to take on more leadership responsibility

- A young, international team with a lot of passion and team spirit

- Employee discount across our assortment

Interested? 

Send us your CV and a short introduction telling us why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.

We'd also like you to answer one question:

Tell us about a marketing campaign, project or experiment you took ownership of. What was your goal, what did you do, and what was the result? 

It doesn't have to be a huge campaign or a perfect success. We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems and what you learn from the things you try.

One last thing: We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application – we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think. 

If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.

Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜

title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
description:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.

This one is for you if:

- You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist

- You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike

- Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.

We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.

Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.

Start: as soon as you can.

Tasks

You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

- Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption

- Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means

- Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans

- Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level

- Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic

- Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge

- Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow

- Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months: 

- Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break

- Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up

- Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to

- Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

- 4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers

- Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up

- Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently

- Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months

- Fluent written and spoken German and English. We work in English internally; customer work happens in German

You're eligible to work in Germany — EU/EEA citizenship, or an existing work or residence permit. We aren't able to sponsor visas for this role.

You'll fit if: 

- You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made

- You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality

- You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity

- You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

- Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones 

- 30 days' holiday

- Deutschlandticket

- Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home

- Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week

- Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter

- The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow

- A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.

How the process runs: 

- Short intro call — 30 minutes

- Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time

- Deep-dive with Felix and the delivery team — 60 minutes

- Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.

We are an employer that actively lives equal opportunity. We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. It doesn't matter where you're from, what religion you belong to, your gender, who you love, how old you are, or whether you live with a disability — you're welcome here.

Questions about the role? Write to Amanda Graham

title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
description:
Kurz und Knapp

Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in München. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Das erwartet dich 

- Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.

- Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.

- Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.

- Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.

- Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.

- Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.

- Bringe deine Ideen ein : Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

Das bringst du mit 

- Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen. 

- Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.

- Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.

- Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.

- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.

- Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen. 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

- Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.

- Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.

- Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.

- Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.

- Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.

- Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.

- Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.

- Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.

Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.

You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.

Responsibilities 

- Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.

- Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.

- Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.

- Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.

- Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.

- Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.

- Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.

Qualifications 

Required: 

- 6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).

- Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.

- Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.

- Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.

- SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.

- A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).

- Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.

- Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).

- Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.

Preferred: 

- Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR. 

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles. 

Pay Range

£80,000 — £90,000 GBP 

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY 

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds 

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Founding Account Executive SMB | Dutch Market (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. 

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As our founding Account Executive for the Dutch market, you'll be the first commercial hire dedicated to the Netherlands. You'll own the full sales cycle end to end, from qualifying inbound demand through to close, while helping shape how we sell in the Dutch market as you go. Processes aren't fully built yet, and you'll be part of building them up. 

Who We Want 

Strong communicator .
You're a native Dutch speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Self-confident. 
You believe in your ability to run and close a conversation without coming across as arrogant.

Comfortable with ambiguity. 
You're energized, not unsettled, by the fact that not everything is defined yet. You'd rather help build the process than be handed one.

Coachable. 
You take direct feedback without getting defensive, and visibly apply it in your next conversation.

Resilient. 
You bounce back quickly from a lost deal or a tough week and keep your activity levels consistently high.

Fast learner. 
You get up to speed on a technical product quickly and can explain it to customers in a way they understand.

Structured .
You keep your pipeline clean and your CRM notes reliable, without anyone having to chase you

Who We Don't Want 

Gets defensive with feedback. 
You take direct feedback personally instead of applying it, and repeat the same mistakes call after call.

Weak written communication. 
You struggle to express yourself clearly and professionally in writing, whether that's emails, CRM notes, or follow-ups.

In it for the paycheck alone. 
You're chasing the salary with no genuine interest in the craft of selling, and it shows in how little curiosity you bring to the work.

Uncomfortable being first. 
You'd rather join an established team than be the one setting the tone for how the Dutch market gets sold.

Your Day To Day 

Demos & Product Presentation (~80%)

- You convince prospects to join a product demo and book the relevant appointments

- You present Superchat's capabilities convincingly and show customers how the product solves their specific challenges

- You act as the voice of the Dutch market in every customer conversation, since there's no established playbook yet to fall back on

Closing (~20%)

- You convince prospects to sign a contract and successfully guide the sales cycle through to close

- You flag patterns in objections or lost deals so the sales process keeps improving as we learn

Stakeholders 

Customers : your most important point of contact day-to-day - from first outreach through demos to close
Sales Team: for joint training, knowledge-sharing, and exchanging best practices across the sales cycle
Customer Success Team : for handover after a successful close and a smooth start to onboarding

Why People Choose Us 

- We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.

- We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.

- We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.

- We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.

- We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture 

- Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.

- Regular company-wide and team events.

- An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.

- An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.

- A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company. 

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you! 

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. 

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

description:
Über uns: Wer/Was ist Artefact? 

Artefact ist eine weltweit führende Beratung für Daten- und KI-Dienstleistungen mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Mit mehr als 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir mit den globalen Marktführern zusammen. An unseren deutschen Standorten befinden wir uns auf einem rasanten Wachstumskurs. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren.

Als Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data & AI Strategy stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Du lieferst nicht nur statische Präsentationen, sondern schlägst die Brücke zwischen technologischen Möglichkeiten und geschäftlichen Anforderungen. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von fokussierten Kurzzeit-Projekten im gehobenen Mittelstand bis hin zu mehrphasigen KI-Transformationen in Großkonzernen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für crossfunktionale Workstreams, treibst datenbasierte Entscheidungen voran und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit.

Das erwartet dich bei uns: 

- Kundenberatung & Strategie: Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen.

- Daten & Analyse: Du sammelst, strukturierst und bereitest Daten für Analysen auf. Mit Tools wie Excel, SQL und Python identifizierst du Trends, Muster und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und kommunizierst diese klar an technische sowie nicht-technische Stakeholder.

- Projektumsetzung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Projekt-Workstreams und stellst eine qualitativ hochwertige, termingerechte Lieferung im Einklang mit den übergeordneten Projektzielen sicher. Dabei arbeitest du kollaborativ in interdisziplinären Teams aus den Bereichen Consulting, Data und Tech.

- Daten- & KI-Lösungen: Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, KI-Use-Cases sowie Business-Intelligence-Lösungen und wirkst bei Governance-Frameworks und Implementierungs-Roadmaps mit.

- Wissenstransfer & Kollaboration: Du trägst zu einer starken Teamkultur bei, indem du dein Wissen teilst, dich über digitale Trends und KI-Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden hältst und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams unterstützt.

title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
description:
Who/What is Artefact? 

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy , you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

What you will do: 

- Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.

- Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.

- Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.

- Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.

- Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.

- Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

Candidate Profile 

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

- Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.

- Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.

- Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.

- Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.

- Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.

- Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).

- Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.

- Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.

- Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why ARTEFACT? 

- Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.

- Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.

- Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.

- Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.

- Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

This position is based in Berlin or Munich. 

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

title: Working Student - Risk Advisory - Disputes & Valuations
description:
Über AlixPartners 

Expertise, Umsetzungsstärke, Verantwortung – AlixPartners steht für messbare Ergebnisse „when it really matters“. Als global agierende Unternehmensberatung helfen wir unseren Klienten dabei, schnell und entschlossen auf ihre wichtigsten Herausforderungen zu reagieren. Unsere erfahrenen Beraterinnen und Berater sind spezialisiert darauf, Unternehmenswerte zu schaffen, zu schützen und wiederherzustellen. Vom „manager magazin“ und der Wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaft für Management & Beratung (WGMB) wurde AlixPartners 2023 als umsetzungsstärkstes Beratungsunternehmen ausgezeichnet. Seit über 40 Jahren unterstützt AlixPartners seine Klienten – mit inzwischen rund 4.000 MitarbeiterInnen in 27 Büros weltweit.

Unser Angebot 

Wirkungsvoll, hands-on und pragmatisch: Bei AlixPartners treibt Ihre Leidenschaft Ihre Karriere – durch hohe Leistung, Initiative und Resultate. Gemeinsam mit sehr erfahrenen Teammitgliedern werden Sie in kleinen Teams, Seite an Seite mit Eigentümer:innen, Vorstandsmitgliedern und Senior Management zusammenarbeiten. Sie liefern schnell umsetzbare Lösungen für dringende Fragestellungen, oft in (zeit-) kritischen Situationen, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht.

Aufgabenbereich 

- Du unterstützt bei der Sachverhaltsaufklärung ("was passierte denn tatsächlich und was hat dies für Auswirkungen auf das Unternehmen gehabt?") 

- Du unterstützt bei der Quantifizierung von Schäden in profilierten, weltweiten Rechtsstreitigkeiten und führst eigene Analysen durch

- Du bewertest relevante Daten wie z.B. aus Broker Reports, Datenbanken, Jahresabschlüssen

- Du unterstützt unsere Kolleg:innen bei der Erstellung von finanzwirtschaftlichen Modellen zur Schadensquantifizierung

- Du führst Finanzanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen durch

- Du erstellst Präsentationen für Kunden und interne Stakeholder und bist an der Erstellung von Gutachten für internationale (Schieds-)Gerichtsverfahren beteiligt

Bewerberprofil 

- Laufendes Masterstudium an einer renommierten Universität mit wirtschaftlichem Hintergrund in Finanzen und Rechnungswesen

- Fließend in Deutsch & Englisch (nahezu jegliche Kommunikation erfolgt auf Englisch)

- Sehr gute akademische Leistungen

title: Solution Architect
description:
About The Role 

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. As we grow with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, their architecture questions get harder: How does Taktile fit into an existing, complex and some-times decades-old core banking system landscape? How do we design for their security, availability, compliance, and integration requirements? Who speaks the language of their enterprise architects?

That's this role. As Solution Architect, you are a senior technical voice in our customer conversations - a sparring partner to enterprise architects at large financial institutions, helping them design how Taktile fits into their broader solution architecture.

What You'll Do as Solution Architect 

- Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.

- Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.

- Own the hardest architecture questions in our deals — integration patterns, deployment models, throughput, latency, security, compliance, data residency — and turn them from blockers into reasons to buy.

- Lead architecture workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and reference architecture reviews with customer stakeholders from engineers up to CTOs.

- Represent Taktile in senior architecture discussions on the customer side, giving their enterprise architects and technical leadership a credible, expert counterpart.

- Build reusable reference architectures, integration blueprints, and best practices that scale across the Forward Deployed Engineering and Sales teams.

- Work across pre-sales and post-sales: supporting Account Executives and Solution Engineers on complex enterprise deals, and partnering with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure what was sold is what gets built.

About You 

- You bring 10+ years of experience in solution or enterprise architecture, with significant time spent working directly with large enterprises — ideally in financial services.

- You have deep, hands-on knowledge of AWS and enterprise integration patterns (event-driven architectures, messaging, APIs, batch, streaming), and you know when to use which.

- You've worked with enterprise-grade legacy systems — core banking platforms, loan origination systems (LOSs), loan management systems (LMS), front-end SDKs, mainframes, on-prem estates — and know what it actually takes to integrate a modern SaaS platform into them.

- You have a solid grounding in security and compliance as they apply to regulated enterprises: authentication and authorization patterns, network architecture, encryption, data residency, and audit requirements.

- You hold your own with the most senior technical stakeholders on the customer side — enterprise architects, Heads of Engineering, CTOs — and are seen as a peer, not a vendor.

- You communicate complex architecture crisply, in writing, on a whiteboard, in a slide deck, and in the room, to both deeply technical and executive audiences.

- You're comfortable operating across pre-sales and post-sales, and you know how to make architecture decisions that are right for the customer and commercially sound.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required) 

- You have experience as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Principal Consultant at a B2B SaaS company, cloud provider, or top-tier consultancy serving financial institutions.

- You have designed architectures involving AI/ML or Generative AI workloads in production.

- You hold relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, TOGAF).

- You have experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security/architecture reviews.

What We Offer 

- Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

- Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

- Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

- Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance 

- We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We at Pleo are on a mission to make spend management surprisingly effective and empowering. We build a product used by thousands of companies across Europe, and our design system is a core part of delivering a consistent, accessible, high-quality experience.

We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to join the Design Systems team. This will help lead the engineering direction and execution of our design system across web and mobile.

What Design Systems does

- 
Own and evolve Telescope , Pleo’s design system (components, patterns, guidelines, and tooling).

- 
Enable product teams to ship faster with consistent UI, accessibility, and quality.

- 
Partner with Design and Engineering across the company to drive adoption and improve the contribution experience.

- 
Steward shared foundations (tokens, components, documentation, and best practices).

What you’ll be doing

As a Staff Engineer in Design Systems, you will be a force multiplier for product delivery and UI quality across Pleo

- 
Set technical direction for key parts of Telescope (architecture, component standards, release practices, and quality bars)

- 
Drive and evolve our contribution model and how teams interact with Design Systems

- 
Own and improve how requests flow into the team (triage, prioritisation, and expectations)

- 
Improve the developer and contributor experience through tooling and automation, including:

- 
Design system visual testing and workflows

- 
Supporting internal operational needs where relevant

- 
Improving how we measure and communicate adoption and system health

- 
Evolving our docs publishing workflow

- 
Lead rituals that keep the team effective and aligned

- 
Represent Design Systems in cross-team initiatives and align stakeholders across Design and Engineering

- 
Coach and mentor engineers, and help grow technical leadership in the frontend community

- 
Contribute hands-on in code. This role blends strategy and execution. You should expect to be coding a meaningful part of the time.

You’ll bring solid experience with

- 
Building and maintaining component libraries or platform-like products that serve multiple teams.

- 
TypeScript and modern frontend engineering (React experience is a plus).

- 
Designing maintainable systems with clear boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

- 
Testing practices and tooling (unit, integration, end-to-end) and a strong quality mindset.

- 
Accessibility and performance best practices for UI systems.

- 
Collaboration with designers and product engineers, and navigating tradeoffs across stakeholders.

Your colleagues would say you

- 
Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

- 
Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

- 
Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

- 
Coach others and create space for people to grow.

- 
Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

Show me the benefits!

- 
Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- 
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 

- 
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- 
We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- 
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- 
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 

- 
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work 

About your application 

- 
English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- 
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- 
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- 
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- 
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .

- 
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- 
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Software Engineer - (Connect Platform)
description:
About Enode 

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

What we're looking for:

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to make Enode’s EV platform more reliable, observable, and efficient.

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform Connect team at Enode, you'll focus on improving the reliability, observability, and scalability of Enode's connectivity layer. This is the part of our API that aggregates integrations with EV chargers, vehicles, and OEM platforms into one cohesive and reliable product for our customers.

This is not an infrastructure or DevOps role. The Platform Connect team owns the product level platform that powers connectivity at Enode, maintaining and extending the layer that links our users to energy devices through consistent, high quality integrations.

You'll take on complex, critical for the business work and see it through, helping keep our platform robust as we scale to more OEMs and partners. Alongside the other senior engineers on the team, you'll help set the technical bar and support the people around you. Expect to move between hands on building, shaping technical direction, and helping teammates, depending on what the team needs most.

Our tech stack centers around a TypeScript based codebase combined with React, Node, AWS, Docker, and PostgreSQL, structured via CDK/CloudFormation.

In this role, you will:

- Build and maintain API integrations with OEMs and energy partners, ensuring they are reliable, performant, and well tested.

- Strengthen the connectivity platform by reducing incidents and improving observability, monitoring, and alerting, including the automations and internal tools that make this easier.

- Take on complex projects and drive them through to release, breaking them into actionable work and delivering with limited hand-holding.

- Help hold a high bar on code quality, testing, and observability, caring about the state of the codebase beyond your own changes.

- Work with product and the team to align platform priorities, balancing stability with delivery.

- Take ownership beyond your own work and support the engineers around you, sharing knowledge and contributing to technical decisions that keep the team aligned.

This role will be right for you, if:

See AI as a strategic lever for engineering work, not just a productivity add on. AI is a real part of how we work as engineers at Enode. We expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. Using it day to day, understanding where it helps and where it falls short, and thinking about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, we're looking for someone eager to get there fast. Additionally: 

- You have experience writing maintainable, testable backend code, ideally in an environment with a lot of API or integration work.

- You're excited about platform engineering in the product sense. Building the connectivity layer that powers integrations, not managing infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines.

- You enjoy building new integrations and making existing systems more reliable and observable, and you're systematic about debugging issues across services and preventing them from recurring.

- You communicate clearly, contribute to technical discussions, and can explain complex topics to non technical stakeholders.

- You take ownership beyond your own work and care about the team. You share knowledge, support teammates, and help improve how the team operates.

description:
